name: Runemaster Arcane Student: Glyphic Overload guarantees Glyphic Ruin critical strikes (#1658)
contract: Arcane Student 300576 (Arcane tree talent, CharacterAdvancement 34665): 'While Glyphic Overload is active, your
Glyphic Ruin is guaranteed to critically strike.' Its one effect is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 modifier of +100 on
family 38 mask2 0x80: Glyphic Overload 520099, whose effect 1 is a flat SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE modifier of 0
on mask0 0x1000, the Glyphic Ruin ranks 801179, 520067-520070 and 572119-572122 (magic class, direct damage).
The native modifier chain applies the talent without a script: an Overload cast with the talent carries +100
critical strike chance for Glyphic Ruin, and Glyphic Ruin consumes the Overload after its hit.
Talent.dbc 27109 also lists 705548 as a second rank, but CharacterAdvancement grants only 300576; 705548 reads
'Increases Spell Damage by $s1% of Intellect' (SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT, 12%, all schools,
Intellect), a native aura. Expected: Overload without the talent leaves Glyphic Ruin at the base chance; with
the talent its effect 1 reads 100, Glyphic Ruin's done chance reaches 100% and a cast critically strikes; the
chance returns to base once the Overload is spent. 705548 adds 12% of Intellect to spell power (QA Test +1000
int stat 300103 supplies 1100 Intellect; the integer bonus truncates by at most 1).
